card.fact_statement: The World Bank announced the payout of a US$150 million catastrophe bond triggered by Hurricane Melissa.
card.source_span: The World Bank also announced the payout of a US$150 million catastrophe bond triggered by Melissa.

target_qa_variants.question: Thamani ya malipo ya dhamana ya janga yaliyotangazwa na Benki ya Dunia na kusababishwa na Kimbunga Melissa ilikuwa nini?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The World Bank also announced the payout of a US$150 million catastrophe bond triggered by Melissa.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'catastrophe bond payout' as 'malipo ya dhamana ya janga' and 'World Bank' as 'Benki ya Dunia'.

backtranslation_en.question: What was the value of the catastrophe bond payout announced by the World Bank and caused by Cyclone Melissa?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answers, preserving the same fact and relation.
